target_customer: Consumers training for fitness goals who use wearables (current site, invite only); ambulance agencies and EMS billing teams (original YC launch product)
problem: People lack a personal coach that checks in proactively. Amby texts workouts, briefings and post-workout analysis using wearable data. The original product automated billing and quality review for ambulance agencies.
business_model: Consumer subscription coaching app (pricing not public); original B2B software for EMS agencies
product_category: AI health and fitness coach over text (current); AI copilot for EMS back office (original)

founders.name: Yos Wagenmans
education: MIT, left the CS M.Eng. program before finishing

technical_complexity.rationale: Wearable data integrations, workout generation and proactive messaging built on commercial LLMs are standard engineering; the EMS billing product needed domain workflows.

defensibility.rationale: Text coaching on top of shared wearable APIs and public models is copyable in weeks, and large wearable makers (Oura, Whoop, Fitbit) shipped AI coaches in 2025.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Oura Advisor launched March 2025 and Whoop and Fitbit shipped AI coaching late 2025 per a search summary; these are after the W25 batch.

market_need_then: Human coaches are expensive and consumers already track fitness with wearables, but no source in this research measured demand for Amby specifically.

branding.domain_note: Uses tryamby.com, a try prefix rather than an exact .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and motivational with short punchy lines such as Not someday. Today.

branding.community_and_virality: Invite only access with friend codes; no wider community found.

brand_strength.rationale: A clear friendly tagline and invite mechanic, but no press or community, and the name collides with other similarly named health companies.

pivots.from: AI copilot for ambulance agencies (EMS billing and quality review)
pivots.to: AI fitness and health coach over text
pivots.why: Not stated. The YC launch post describes EMS, while the YC tagline and live site describe a text coach; date not found

outcome_analysis: Amby Health is active with two founders from MIT and big tech backgrounds. It was launched in the W25 batch as an EMS copilot and the current site and YC tagline describe a consumer text coach, an undated pivot whose reason is not public. Funding is unconfirmed and large wearable brands entered AI coaching, so the outcome is open.
notes: A 500K pre-seed (March 2025, SBXi named) appears only in aggregators and is unverified; another lists 50K; no Form D was reported on EDGAR. No round recorded. Competition empty: sources found were dated 2026 or after the batch (Nudge February 2026, Ryke), and Oura Advisor March 2025 was not directly fetched. One source puts the CEO start at November 2024 while YC says founded 2025. Completeness pass: the roughly 500K pre-seed (2025-03) is now recorded; it rests on aggregators (Signalbase, VCBacked, FundedIQ) and no primary source or Form D confirms it. PitchBook lists 50K total, which conflicts. Caplight names Sequoia Capital as a seed participant, not recorded.
